transcript.speaker: Doctor
transcript.text: Hello. Hello Priya, what is your problem?

transcript.speaker: Doctor
transcript.text: Hello Rahul. What is your problem?

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I'm having difficulty in breathing, Doctor. I... I don't know what happened.

transcript.speaker: Doctor
transcript.text: Okay, tell me where did you feel exactly? When did you feel exactly started difficulty in breathing?

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I have had severe stomach ache. From yesterday I had fast food, from then onwards I'm feeling nausea, stomach ache, difficulty in breathing, etc.

transcript.speaker: Doctor
transcript.text: Okay, so I'll check your temperature and check your mouth. Open your mouth. Your mouth has already mildly red. So avoid taking outside food for now. Try to take fruits and vegetables as much as possible. Don't drink soft drinks. Go for healthy coconut water, and please make sure to have some rest for 2 days at least.

summary.chief_complaint: Difficulty in breathing, stomach ache, and nausea.
summary.consultation_overview: Patient presented with difficulty in breathing, stomach ache, and nausea after consuming fast food yesterday. Doctor examined the patient, noted mild redness in the mouth, and provided dietary and lifestyle advice.
summary.history_of_present_illness: Patient reported developing severe stomach ache, nausea, and difficulty in breathing after consuming fast food yesterday.
summary.treatment_plan: Avoid outside food and soft drinks. Increase consumption of fruits, vegetables, and coconut water. Take rest for at least 2 days.
advice: Consume fruits and vegetables as much as possible
Rest for at least two days
